A.claim: At every modulus m, a Beal counterexample forces a in <A>, b in <B>, c in <C> with a+b = c mod m, because {X^x mod m : x >= 3} is exactly the cyclic subgroup <X> when gcd(X,m)=1. Combined with the kernel-verified pairwise coprimality this rejects 77.7% of coprime residue triples at m = 240.

B.claim: Of 405 reduced signatures with exponents in {3,4,5,7,11,13,17,19,23} and x<=y, this project can cite a recorded result for only 40. The remaining 365 are signatures THIS PROJECT cannot justify - not signatures that are open in the literature.
